properties.name: Singharpal beach
properties.description: Singharpal and Udayakani beaches is for souls who want to just hear the susurration of sea waves and its breeze.

properties.name: Turtle beach
properties.description: As the name says, it is nesting place for the Olive Ridley turtles. There is hardly any presence of tourists on this beach.

properties.name: Chandrabhaga beach
properties.description: Popular ocean retreat near Konark sun temple with clean sand, swimming, surfing, sailing, ATV rentals and sea-food vendors.

properties.name: Chandipur beach
properties.description: During low tides the beach recedes upto 5kms offering visitors an opportunity to walk on the sea bed.

properties.name: Puri beach
properties.description: Tourists visit the Puri beach for its undeniable charm, its sun, sand and stunning views of the Bay of Bengal.

properties.name: Mahabalipuram beach
properties.description: The beach lies on the shore of Bay of Bengal and comprises of some astonishing ancient rock-cut sculptures.

properties.name: Promenade beach
properties.description: Rock beach (Plage de la promenade) is the popular stretch of beachfront in the city of Puducherry, along the Bay of Bengal.

properties.name: Paradise beach
properties.description: Paradise beach near Puducherry is widely famous for its unparalleled charm, pristine shores, and jaw-dropping scenery.

properties.name: Pichavaram mangrove forest
properties.description: A hidden treasure near Chidabaram beach is one of the largest mangrove forests in India. Row boat is recommended to see the beauty of the place.

properties.name: Nagaon beach
properties.description: Bustling beach featuring a range of water sports, camel rides, bike rentals and nearby sea-food restaurants.

properties.name: Revdanda beach
properties.description: An abandoned fort stands in the jungle fringing this remote and tranquil beach with black sand.

properties.name: Korlai beach
properties.description: Set below an old fort and lighthouse, this secluded beach provides walking, fishing and sunset views.
